title: MZ Kadajah ABS - A Dynamic, CSS-Powered Action Battle System!

posts.author: Kadajah
posts.body:
Hey everyone!
I'm incredibly excited to introduce a new plugin I've been working on:
Kadajah ABS
, a complete Action Battle System for RPG Maker MZ!
This is a comprehensive, lightweight, and highly customizable Action Battle System designed to bring a new level of energy and excitement to your RPG Maker MZ projects.
​
What is Kadajah ABS?​
Kadajah ABS transforms your map into a dynamic battlefield. It's built from the ground up to be intuitive for players and incredibly powerful for developers, allowing you to create a seamless action RPG experience where every sword swing and magic blast happens in real-time.
Core Features at a Glance:​
Unchained Movement:
Break free from the grid with fluid 8-directional movement, giving your players complete control and making exploration and combat feel more natural and responsive.
A Trinity of Combat:
Master a versatile combat system featuring swift melee attacks, strategic ranged projectiles, and devastating area-of-effect (AoE) magic spells, each with its own unique feel and resource cost.
Tactical Mobility:
Dodge, weave, and explore with a built-in jump/dash ability. It’s not just for combat—use it to cross gaps and create more engaging map designs!
Intelligent Enemies & Epic Bosses:
Bring your world to life with enemies that actively pursue the player and bosses that unleash devastating, telegraphed AoE attacks. Design epic encounters that test player skill and strategy.
Deep Stat Integration:
This is more than just an action game—it's an action
RPG
. Every stat in your database matters. Attack, Defense, Agility, and Luck all play a crucial role in calculating damage, attack speed, critical hits, and skill cooldowns.
On-the-Fly Equipment Swapping:
Empower your players with three customizable equipment slots they can switch between instantly with a single button press, allowing for tactical changes mid-battle.
Strategy Matters: The Elemental System​
Kadajah ABS features a fully integrated elemental system. Infuse your weapons and skills with elements like Fire, Ice, Thunder, and more. Enemies can have unique weaknesses and resistances, forcing players to think strategically and adapt their gear and tactics to overcome different challenges. This adds a layer of depth that rewards preparation and observation.
Unleash Your Creativity with CSS Animations!​
This is where Kadajah ABS truly changes the game. Say goodbye to the limitations of the built-in animation editor! This plugin allows you to design
completely custom attack animations using CSS
.
What does this mean for you?
Unparalleled Visual Flair:
Create silky-smooth slashing arcs, devastating impact effects, brilliant elemental infusions, and complex magical explosions that are difficult to execute with traditional sprite sheets.
Blazing-Fast Performance:
CSS animations are rendered directly by the game's engine, making them incredibly lightweight and performant, ensuring your combat stays fluid even with lots of action on screen.
Total Artistic Freedom:
Your imagination is the only limit. If you can imagine a visual effect, you can create it with CSS. This feature gives you the power to give your game a unique visual identity that stands out from the crowd.
Whether you're a beginner looking for an easy-to-use action system or a veteran developer wanting a powerful canvas for deep customization, Kadajah ABS is built for you.
Breathe new life into your project and create the action RPG you've always imagined!

posts.body:
caethyril said:
@Kadajah
- hi!
To clarify: there is a version of the plugin included in your free demo project. Is that version of the plugin free for people to use in their own projects?
Click to expand...
Hey, everything okay?
I apologize in advance if I'm violating any community terms.
To answer your question, the current version on Itch.io has a game ID lock. Furthermore, the demo plugin code has been obfuscated, meaning the parameters are not available for editing in the RPG Maker dashboard. Only users with programming knowledge would be able to change the parameters directly in the code.
If I remove the game ID lock, any player will be able to use the plugin in their projects. It's not a problem, but it would be a version without parameter control. All the features are there, but editing them is complicated.
I can remove the ID lock and update the itch.io demo file if that aligns with community disclosure guidelines.

Hey, sorry for the delay. I checked with the other mods: here we only allow plugins that offer a free version that people can use in their projects. So if you want to share your plugin here, you'll have to remove the game ID lock on the free demo plugin.
It is expected that the free version of a paid plugin will be feature-limited (e.g. no plugin parameters for customisation), so no worries there~
